invariants.rationale: The method always returns an instance produced by execute(), so result should not be null.
The returned write metadata should have a non-null list of WriteStatus.
The write statuses field in the result must be a List as per the method signature.
The method passes hoodieRecords to the action executor; a null would likely cause an exception before return.
instantTime is passed to the action executor and commit logic, so it should not be null at exit.
